opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "And structure cost is around INR20 to INR25 lakh rupees in INR, including all the costs to start up a business over there." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

The global service robotics market is projected to exceed $107 billion by 2030.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The global service robotics market is expected to exceed $107 billion by 2030." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: India's AV hardware market is anticipated to grow at a CAGR of roughly 9.8% through 2030.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "India’s AV hardware market is expected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 9.8% through 2030, while the digital signage market is projected to grow at around 10% CAGR and the video conferencing market at approximately 11% CAGR over the same period." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company deployed and sold over 400 robots across various industries during FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "During the year, we also achieved a significant operational milestone by successfully deploying and selling over 400 robots across various industries, further strengthening the market presence of our Albotix robotics platform and validating the growing..." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Nanta Tech secured an AI automation solution order worth INR6.6 crores from Pointer Insurance Broker Private Limited.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Further reinforcing our growing capability in enterprise AI solutions, we recently secured a significant AI automation solution order worth INR6.6 crores from Pointer Insurance Broker Private Limited." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The Experience Center is nearing completion, with approximately 95% of the work done.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "We have been working to get our Experience Center up and ready. Almost 95% of the work is already being done." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -2.15 pp, DII -9.76 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S7/W10/O28/T4), led by 'The company expects to achieve around 50% revenue growth in FY27', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
